description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on B'Onions valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 20.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates on specific commodities (B'Onions) and rescinds a previous order. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
